retraction.reason: Re-read on 24 September under A14(6) against the bar that replaced M44b’s: a record earns its place by carrying at least one honest edge to anything already in the atlas, and nothing is written in order to keep one. The corpus is 859 active events across all five lanes, not the Portuguese core M44b judged this against. The atlas holds no Portuguese event of the law on domestic violence and no other state’s ratification of the Istanbul convention, and the world corpus has added nothing it touches. Its only available neighbours here are the European treaties, and an edge to those would be true of a dozen records and argue nothing. It stays retracted under the new bar and not under M44b’s.

title: Convention on preventing and combating violence against women and domestic violence
summary: Wikidata item Q1697391, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Council of Europe convention against gender violence signed in Istanbul, Turkey". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
